svākāra: svākāra [su+ākāra] being of good disposition Vin I.6.
svākkhāta: svākkhāta [su+akkhāta; on the long ā cp. Geiger, P.Gr. § 7; BSk. svākhyāta] well preached Vin I.12, 187; II.199; M I.67; A I.34; II.56; Sn 567. Opp. durakkhāta Vism 213 (in detail).
svāgata: svāgata [su+āgata] 1. welcome Vin II.11; Th 2, 337; ThA 236. -- 2. learnt by heart Vin II.95, 249; A IV.140 (pātimokkhāni). See sāgata.
svātana: svātana [cp. Sk. œvastana; Geiger, P.Gr. § 6, 54] relating to the morrow; dat. °--nāya for the following day Vin I.27; D I.125; J I.11; DhA I.314; IV.12.
sve: sve (adv.) [cp. Sk. œvas] to--morrow Vin II.77; D I.108, 205; J I.32, 243; II.47; VvA 230; svedivasa DhA I.103. The diæretic form is suve, e. g. Pv IV.15; Mhvs 29, 17; and doubled suve suve day after day Dh 229; DhA III.329; J V.507.
